Privacy Policy

Updated 26 October 2026

1. Enquiries and orders

When you submit an enquiry, we receive your name, telephone number, optional email address and notes, chosen package, quoted price, preferred payment method and enquiry reference. Submissions are processed and stored using Netlify Forms so Fabrica Invest can review and respond to your request. Submitting the form does not take a payment or subscribe you to marketing.

2. Optional website analytics

With your permission, this website uses Google Analytics 4 to understand page views, visits, approximate countries and cities, devices, referral sources, offer selections and successful enquiry counts. We do not send the name, phone number, email address or notes you enter in our form as Analytics event parameters. Countries and cities are approximate, not your precise location.

3. Audience demographics

If you separately allow audience demographics, Google signals may provide aggregated age ranges, gender and interests using data associated with consenting Google Account users who have Ads Personalization enabled. This uses advertising-related Google data and consent settings. Availability depends on Google's settings and privacy thresholds; age is unknown for many visitors.

4. Your choices

Optional analytics and demographics are off until you allow them. You can accept, reject, or choose these settings separately. Use the Privacy choices button in the footer at any time to change your decision. The enquiry form continues working when optional analytics is declined. Changing your choice stops future collection; it does not automatically remove previously collected data.

5. Browser storage

Your currency preference and privacy decision are stored locally in your browser. Privacy choices are requested again after 180 days. After a successful enquiry, this browser tab stores the package and confirmation reference, but not the form's personal contact details. Google Analytics may set cookies when you allow analytics. Declining later disables our Analytics integration and clears its first-party analytics cookies from this site.

6. Optional WhatsApp contact

You may separately choose to contact us on WhatsApp. A draft opens for you to review and send; submitting the enquiry form does not automatically send a WhatsApp message. WhatsApp handles information under its own privacy terms.

7. Service providers and contact

Netlify hosts this website and processes form submissions. Google processes optional Analytics data. Their services may involve international data processing. Contact Fabrica Invest on +212 650 290 546 about your submitted information or privacy requests. Business registration details and retention arrangements remain subject to confirmation by the operator.
